source: CAMIL GE-V-13 · Page 25 · Living Room and Kitchen (living room half)
notes: Five words dropped as dead technology, the same problem as the Communications page:
'record player', 'tape deck', 'tape recorder', 'short wave band' and 'T.V. set', which is
only a dated way of saying television.
CENTER TABLE replaced with 'coffee table'. The page's term is a literal rendering of mesa
de centro; no American says it.

area.name: The Living Room
area.description: La sala: los muebles donde te sientas, el televisor y el equipo de sonido, las lámparas y los cuadros.

units.name: Furniture
units.topic: What you sit on and put things on in a living room. A loveseat is a small sofa for two

units.name: Television and radio
units.topic: The television and the sound system, and the words for what comes out of them

units.name: Lamps and decoration
units.topic: Light and what hangs on the wall. A bulb is the glass part that gives the light
